rules.title: Annual Rent Increase 2026-2027
rules.requirement: The annual allowable increase for rent-controlled units is 1.6% for the period of March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

notes: The document specifies the 1.6% cap for rent-controlled units but does not explicitly define the criteria for 'rent-controlled' status within this specific announcement.
